clue.text: Sort of loaf around quietly — and get married

indicators.note: around tells us the sliced loaf wraps itself round the quiet letter

parts.note: a sliced loaf is a kind of bread sold ready cut
P is short for piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone told to stop lazing about quietly and go and get wed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loaf' looks like a verb (to laze), but it is bread. 'and get' is linking.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British slang: to get spliced is to get married, joined like two ropes.

clue.text: Plan faster attack from the air

indicators.note: to plan is to arrange, so the letters of faster are rearranged

explanation.surface: A call to organise a speedier aerial assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plan' rearranges FASTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition: to strafe is to fire on ground targets from low-flying aircraft.

clue.text: Left one extremely irritable

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
very means extremely

explanation.surface: One person was left feeling very cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: livery once meant peevish, as if from a disordered liver.

clue.text: Scold fans rioting about end of fancy sugar

indicators.note: about makes the jumbled letters wrap round the final letter
rioting throws the letters of scold fans into disorder
end of picks the final letter of fancy

explanation.surface: Telling off rowdy fans for being fussy about sweet things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rioting' rearranges SCOLDFANS into CANDFLOSS, which goes 'about' Y, the end of 'fancy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: candyfloss is spun sugar on a stick, sold at British fairs.

clue.text: Banned hot issue revealing Indian attire

indicators.note: revealing shows the letters lying across the phrase banned hot issue

explanation.surface: A prohibited controversy exposes Indian clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revealing' says the answer is inside 'banneD HOT Issue'.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition: a dhoti is a loincloth worn by men in India.

clue.text: Inspiration found in most of top puzzles

indicators.note: found in says the inspiring figure sits inside the shortened word
most of drops the final letter from the word for top

parts.note: to top someone is to beat them, to best them
a muse is a source of artistic inspiration

explanation.surface: A setter's muse is discovered among the finest crosswords.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims BEST to BES, which then holds MUSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bemuse someone is to bewilder or confuse them.

clue.text: Analyse sudden failure to work

definitions.meaning: to examine by splitting into parts
a collapse, as of a car or engine

explanation.surface: Examining why something has abruptly stopped functioning.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a verb, to break down figures, and a noun, a mechanical collapse.

clue.text: Mare rears up, taking in energy drink

indicators.note: taking in places the energy symbol inside the reversed horse word
rears up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a dam is a mother horse, a mare
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A horse rearing after an energy drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rears up' turns DAM into MAD; 'energy drink' looks like one phrase but splits.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: mead is an alcoholic beverage made from fermented honey.

clue.text: Bargains will include favourite pieces

indicators.note: will include puts the favourite inside the bargains

parts.note: a snip is a bargain
a pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: Sale goods will feature some favourite items.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: snippets are small scraps or fragments.

clue.text: Stars must welcome role turning up in such hot spots

indicators.note: must welcome puts the turned-up role inside the stars

parts.note: suns are stars

indicators.note: turning up in a down entry means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a part is a role

explanation.surface: Film stars should accept roles in sunny holiday resorts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' turns PART into TRAP. 'in such' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition: a suntrap is a sheltered spot that catches the warmth of the sun.

clue.text: Flier seen as headless chicken

indicators.note: headless asks us to remove the first letter of the word for chicken

parts.note: chicken as an adjective means cowardly, craven

explanation.surface: A bird is spotted running around like a headless chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken' looks like the bird but means cowardly; 'headless' drops the C of CRAVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the raven is a large black bird, so something that flies.

clue.text: Handling speech about evacuation of Prague

indicators.note: about tells us the speech goes round the emptied city

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech

indicators.note: evacuation empties a word, leaving only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A speech on handling the evacuation of the Czech capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evacuation' sounds like a crisis plan for Prague, but it empties the word, keeping only its first and last letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the operation of a machine is the handling or working of it.

clue.text: Rest, seeing two score 1,000 in victories

parts.note: a score is twenty, so two score is forty

indicators.note: in places the thousand inside the word for victories

parts.note: victories are wins
K, from kilo, stands for a thousand

explanation.surface: A sportsman rests after reckoning his wins in the thousands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seeing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a short sleep or nap during the day is called forty winks.

clue.text: Football team ultimately lacking incentive

indicators.note: ultimately lacking means the team's name loses its final letter

parts.note: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club

explanation.surface: A football team that, at the end of the day, has no motivation.
explanation.walkthrough: SPURS is Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a spur is something that urges one on, a stimulus.

clue.text: Signals get her pals to change

indicators.note: to change means the letters of get her pals are altered

explanation.surface: Someone signals for a woman's friends to alter something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to change' rearranges GETHERPALS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to telegraph is to signal or make known in advance.

clue.text: Poet's trembling after damn lad loses cool

indicators.note: after puts the shaken poet's letters behind the curse and the boy

parts.note: blow is a mild curse, like damn
a son is a lad

indicators.note: trembling shakes up the letters of the word poets

explanation.surface: A poet quivers after some wretched youth loses his temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trembling' rearranges POETS into ESTOP.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to blow one's top is to explode with anger, to lose one's temper.

clue.text: Chap is beset by troubles and has casual affairs

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by the troubles

parts.note: woes are troubles
a man is a chap

explanation.surface: A man in trouble who sleeps around.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition: a man who womanises pursues casual affairs with women.

clue.text: Carol upset during a nervous reaction? Don't know

indicators.note: during places the upset carol within the other pieces

parts.note: a tic is a nervous twitch

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the word over, reading it backwards

parts.note: a carol is a song

explanation.surface: A singer twitches over a carol; asked about faith, they cannot say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns SONG to GNOS. 'Don't know' is a noun here, as in polls.
explanation.definitionFit: Analogy: an agnostic holds that whether God exists cannot be settled, an undecided position.

clue.text: Voting system is set in genuine retaliation

indicators.note: set in places the voting system and is inside the word for genuine

parts.note: real means genuine
PR stands for proportional representation, an electoral system

explanation.surface: A new electoral system is installed as genuine payback.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a reprisal is an act of revenge or retaliation.

clue.text: Mechanic's musical brother with the old-fashioned backing

definitions.note: the possessive-looking ending stands for is, so the clue reads as mechanic is followed by the wordplay; the definition itself is just the noun for a car repairer

parts.note: Grease is a famous stage and film musical
a monk is a brother in a religious order

indicators.note: backing reverses the old word for the

parts.note: ye is an archaic spelling of the

explanation.surface: A mechanic's taste in musicals and his sibling's quaint support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns YE into EY.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: a grease monkey is a car mechanic, from the oily nature of the work.

clue.text: Resign or expect to take cut

indicators.note: to take signals the answer is taken out of the run resign or expect

explanation.surface: Advice to quit or expect a pay cut.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits inside 'resIGN OR Expect'. 'cut' is to snub someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to cut someone is to snub, to pretend not to see them.

clue.text: A former girlfriend's rumoured extension

indicators.note: rumoured means heard, so this is a homophone

parts.note: a former girlfriend is an ex, so this says an ex

explanation.surface: Gossip about an old flame building on to her house.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', a link before 'rumoured'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an annexe is a building added on, an extension.

clue.text: Tropical plant depicted by fine artist

parts.note: OK means fine
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A tropical plant painted by a skilled artist.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for Royal Academician, a member of Britain's Royal Academy of Arts. 'depicted by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: okra, or lady's fingers, is a vegetable plant grown in warm climates.

clue.text: Speak sharply, confronting monster one's found in the garden

parts.note: to snap is to speak sharply
a dragon is a mythical monster

explanation.surface: A gardener snaps while facing a fearsome beast lurking among the plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confronting' just puts the two pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the snapdragon, or antirrhinum, is a common flower in gardens.

clue.text: Bother! Last of tomato sauce

parts.note: a pest is a bother, a nuisance

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of tomato

explanation.surface: An exclamation as the final tomato sauce runs out.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: pesto is an Italian basil sauce served with pasta.

clue.text: Trace ring

definitions.meaning: a faint vestige or reminder of something

explanation.surface: Track down a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a lingering trace of something, and a verb, to resound.

clue.text: Precedents set in cricket trials?

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match
court cases are trials

explanation.surface: Prior rulings laid down in cricket trial matches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set in' is a link. A Test is a full international match in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a test case is a legal action whose result sets a precedent for others.

clue.text: Showing a tendency to be lying

definitions.meaning: being liable or inclined to something

explanation.surface: Someone inclined to tell untruths.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: being inclined to something, and lying flat on the front.

clue.text: Insensitive Opposition leader with American chasing visit

indicators.note: chasing puts the leader and the American behind the visit

parts.note: to call is to visit

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of opposition

parts.note: US means American

explanation.surface: An unfeeling party chief who comes after a US envoy's visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: callous people are heartless and unfeeling towards others.

clue.text: Disgusting display following outside broadcast

indicators.note: following puts the display after the broadcast abbreviation

parts.note: a scene is a display, as in making a scene

explanation.surface: A revolting spectacle shown after a live outdoor transmission.
explanation.walkthrough: An outside broadcast is TV made on location, not in the studio.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something obscene is offensive or repugnant.
